item.title: Q2 Billings Area Weather: Warmer & windier Sunday with a rollercoaster next week
item.description: We had plenty of wind and mild temperatures on Saturday in Montana and Wyoming. The air will warm further and we'll have stronger wind on Sunday. An active return to winter comes next week, too.

item.title: Loved ones remember life of Laurel teen after fatal crash
item.description: Nearly 100 balloons lifted into the sky in honor of Joshua Redman, a 16-year-old his family describes as energetic, daring, and the kind of person who always made others smile.

item.title: Helena native Sean O’Malley booked for historic UFC White House card
item.description: Helena’s Sean O’Malley is scheduled to fight on the UFC’s upcoming White House card, the promotion announced Saturday night. O'Malley will face Canadian contender Aiemann Zahabi.
